windowed._comment: Track 2 (STRETCH, deploy/stm32n6/EFFICIENCY_REWORK_PLAN.md): smaller STFT (256/128 = 16ms/8ms framing, 129 bins) for ~24-32ms algorithmic latency AND 2x frames/sec so emit_T=2 amortizes per-call epoch overhead 2x. Same 192/384 mag_compressed backbone + windowed export wrapper. L = sum_blocks (K-1)*D = 42 (topology-fixed, independent of STFT). window width = L + emit_T = 44. drop_nyquist slices 129->128 for HW alignment. Trains from scratch (frontend/backend dims differ from the 257-bin v5 weights, so no warm-start). Accept only if int8 PESQ holds >= 2.85.
